title: Study 3 interface-calibration protocol draft-v0.3
description: Structural and decision-bearing schema for the Study 3 interface-calibration protocol draft-v0.3. The structural skeleton is exhaustive: every object closes its property set, so a removed key and an injected key are both rejected. Layered on top of it are the constants that carry decision authority, so a draft that flips a frozen flag, moves an alpha, reintroduces a second I3 floor, shrinks the across-profile denominator, changes the number of variants per contrast cluster or restores a decision role to the retired paired procedure fails validation rather than merely reading differently.
